reason: My crew already logs runs on Strava or Nike and organizes everything in our KakaoTalk open chat, and half of them are on iPhone, so a crew-run app that's Android-only is dead on arrival for us. The SUP points and virtual shoes don't pull me either — if I can't cash them out, they're just a game I don't have time for while I'm training for my 10K.
objection: Crew running only works if the whole crew joins, and the iPhone people in my crew literally can't. On top of that, points I can't cash out are pointless to me — fixing and upgrading fake shoes feels like a chore, not a reward.
would_change_my_mind: An iPhone version so my whole crew could join the same room and start together.
